b2-kulpolitika-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Visegrád Meeting
b2-kulpolitika-01.scenario: On a tour of the royal palace at Visegrád, the guide, Judit, asks you what happened here in 1335.
b2-kulpolitika-01.prompt: Tell Judit who met at Visegrád in 1335 and what, according to tradition, they agreed about trade routes. End with one cautious suggestion.
cues: Say what they agreed about trade routes
b2-kulpolitika-01.target: Károly Róbert Visegrádon fogadta a cseh és a lengyel királyt. A hagyomány szerint új kereskedelmi útvonalakról állapodtak meg. Indokolt volna, hogy a térség vezetői ma is találkozzanak.
b2-kulpolitika-01.english: Charles Robert received the Bohemian and the Polish king at Visegrád. According to tradition they agreed on new trade routes. It would be justified for the region's leaders to meet today too.
b2-kulpolitika-01.canDo: I can say who met at Visegrád in 1335 and what they are said to have agreed.

b2-kulpolitika-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Visegrád Meeting of 1991
b2-kulpolitika-02.scenario: In a seminar about the V4, the teacher, Dr Ilona Kovács, asks you about the Visegrád meeting of 1991.
b2-kulpolitika-02.prompt: Tell Dr Kovács who met at Visegrád in February 1991. Then say politely that you would consider closer cooperation desirable.
cues: Say politely what you would consider desirable
b2-kulpolitika-02.target: 1991 februárjában Visegrádon találkozott Antall József, Václav Havel és Lech Wałęsa. Én kívánatosnak tartanám a szorosabb együttműködést.
b2-kulpolitika-02.english: In February 1991 József Antall, Václav Havel and Lech Wałęsa met at Visegrád. I would consider closer cooperation desirable.
b2-kulpolitika-02.canDo: I can say who met at Visegrád in February 1991 and what the V4 aimed for.

b2-kulpolitika-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Gas Pipelines and Roads
b2-kulpolitika-03.scenario: At the transport museum in Budapest, the guide, Péter, shows a map of gas pipelines and roads.
b2-kulpolitika-03.prompt: Tell Péter what the Visegrád states strive for and what the new interconnector contributes to.
cues: Say what the states strive for
Say what the interconnector contributes to
b2-kulpolitika-03.target: A visegrádi országok az energiabiztonság megteremtésére törekednek. Az új vezeték hozzájárul a stabilitáshoz.
b2-kulpolitika-03.english: The Visegrád countries strive to create energy security. The new pipeline contributes to stability.
b2-kulpolitika-03.canDo: I can explain why Central European states built North-South gas and road links.

b2-kulpolitika-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Unanimity in the EU
b2-kulpolitika-04.scenario: In a discussion club about the EU, the moderator, Zsófia, asks what the Hungarian side said about unanimity in foreign policy.
b2-kulpolitika-04.prompt: Tell Zsófia what the Hungarian side insisted on. Then say politely what its delegation would do about qualified majority voting.
cues: Say what the Hungarian diplomacy insisted on
Say politely what the delegation would do
b2-kulpolitika-04.target: A magyar diplomácia ragaszkodott az egyhangúság elvéhez. A magyar fél fenntartásait fejezné ki a minősített többséggel szemben.
b2-kulpolitika-04.english: Hungarian diplomacy insisted on the principle of unanimity. The Hungarian side would express reservations about qualified majority voting.
b2-kulpolitika-04.canDo: I can describe two views of the EU's future: a closer union and a 'Europe of Nations' (nemzetek Európája).

b2-kulpolitika-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Connectivity
b2-kulpolitika-05.scenario: In an economics class, the teacher, Dr Gábor Nagy, asks what 'connectivity' means in the text about Hungary's foreign economic strategy.
b2-kulpolitika-05.prompt: Tell Dr Nagy what connectivity means according to the text. Then say politely that it would be fair to take the Debrecen investments into account.
cues: Say politely what would be fair
b2-kulpolitika-05.target: A konnektivitás a szöveg szerint azt jelenti, hogy sok piaccal tartanak kapcsolatot. Méltányos volna figyelembe venni a debreceni beruházásokat is.
b2-kulpolitika-05.english: According to the text, connectivity means keeping contact with many markets. It would be fair to take the Debrecen investments into account too.
b2-kulpolitika-05.canDo: I can explain what 'connectivity' means in Hungary's foreign economic strategy, as the text puts it.

b2-kulpolitika-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: From 1335 to the V4
b2-kulpolitika-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a study trip to Visegrád, the guide, Judit, asks you to sum up what you learned.
b2-kulpolitika-consolidation.prompt: Tell Judit in a few sentences about the meetings of 1335 and 1991. End with one polite suggestion.
b2-kulpolitika-consolidation.target: 1335-ben Visegrádon három király találkozott, 1991-ben pedig Antall, Havel és Wałęsa találkoztak ugyanott. Indokolt volna, hogy a térség országai tovább egyeztessenek.
b2-kulpolitika-consolidation.english: In 1335 three kings met at Visegrád, and in 1991 Antall, Havel and Wałęsa met in the same place. It would be justified for the countries of the region to keep consulting each other.
b2-kulpolitika-consolidation.canDo: I can sum up in a few sentences how Central European states cooperated from 1335 to the V4.
